answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment rather than ephemeral identity. Like a river carving stone, the network anchors trust in scarce economic resources. An attacker attempting to fabricate identities must acquire quartz-hard stakes, as decentralization renders the fable of costless digital abundance void. The security rests on the prohibitive expense of acquiring sufficient assets to manipulate consensus, effectively gating network influence behind provable economic skin.
